nodes.label: Schools Implementation Status Roadmap
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth for what is built; also the body of the schools pull request. Derived from the production-readiness audit, the portal build contract, site-data.ts and lib/marketing/pricing.ts.

nodes.label: Permanent story IDs and fixed structure
nodes.rationale: Commits, branches and changelog entries reference IDs, so an abandoned story becomes parked rather than deleted or renumbered. Changelog rows land one commit behind because a commit cannot contain its own hash and amending changes the hash again.

nodes.label: A story is a promise to a person
nodes.rationale: If a row cannot be phrased as somebody being able to do something it is scope notes, not a story. A story is done when its acceptance signal can be demonstrated, not when code exists.

nodes.label: Where a feature lives — surface allocation rule
nodes.rationale: Classroom work lives in the teacher portal, administration on the admin dashboard, a student's own work in the student portal. Oversight is not the same as doing: 'which registers were not taken' is admin, taking one is not. Name the person who does it and that name decides the surface.

nodes.label: Portal build contract — prototypes are the contract
nodes.rationale: Portals do not use the dashboard shell; each owns its chrome. Prototypes in docs/design-system/portals/ are replicated not reinterpreted, and every feature in a demo is required — hence one story per capability rather than per screen.

nodes.label: Design-system composition rules
nodes.rationale: Never roll a new primitive; compose from @corelithzw/react, read props from the .d.ts not from memory, role tokens only, filters are dropdowns not pill rows, year group is navigation not a filter, people have faces, the library is a grid of covers.

nodes.label: Schools Definition of Done
nodes.rationale: tsc, eslint, vitest, next build, screenshot verification at 390x844 and 768x1024, tokens only, and every privileged action writes a PlatformAuditEvent with companyId-scoped queries.

nodes.label: e2e/visual-pass.spec.ts
nodes.rationale: Skipped unless VISUAL_PASS=1 because it needs a tenant hostname, PLATFORM_ROOT_DOMAIN and a password user. It was wrong twice — passing over screenshots of two different sign-in pages — so it now asserts the page's own heading: proving what a page is beats enumerating what it is not. Its overflow measure now distinguishes containers that scroll from genuinely clipped elements.

nodes.label: Iteration 0 — Truth and safety
nodes.rationale: Adds no feature; makes the existing pack honest — no fabricated screens, no identity by string match, no unguarded money.

nodes.label: Iteration 1 — The domain a school runs on
nodes.rationale: Timetable, calendar, assessments/grading scheme, admissions pipeline, year roll-over, boarding constraints, teacher-employee link, health records, homework, library, lesson plans, resources, goals, meetings, transport, bulk timetabling and bulk subject allocation.

nodes.label: Iteration 2 — Money correctness
nodes.rationale: Decimal(14,2), USD/ZWG currency and exchange rate, school AccountingSourceType members, duplicate-invoice constraint, overpayment as credit, refunds, fiscalisation and audit events on the six privileged fee actions.

nodes.label: S-2.4 partial unique index on fee invoices
nodes.rationale: A plain unique on (companyId, studentId, termId) breaks two supported workflows — a voided invoice would block its own replacement, and a class legitimately carries several fee structures per term. What shipped is a partial unique on (companyId, studentId, termId, feeStructureId) WHERE status <> 'VOIDED', with bulk generate treating P2002 as a skip, which also closes the two-bursars-at-once race a pre-check cannot.

nodes.label: Iteration 3 — Provisioning
nodes.rationale: provisionSchool, migration replay verification (migrate deploy plus an empty migrate diff both directions — a deploy that succeeds into the wrong schema has fixed nothing), and a staged, previewed, reversible data migration add-on.

nodes.label: Iteration 4 — Record surface
nodes.rationale: The record page already exists but is hard-wired to one module's tables. This makes it record-type agnostic behind a registry, re-keys tasks/comments/mentions/followers/files by subjectType+subjectId, and points the school's six record types at it rather than writing a school-specific copy.

nodes.label: Iteration 5 — Documents
nodes.rationale: Invoice, receipt, statement, report card, admission/transfer letters, class list and register through the shared pipeline. The bill is addressed to the guardian not the child; report cards need both an open publish window and a PUBLISHED sheet; every amount is Decimal to the string.

nodes.label: Iteration 6 — Portals (parent, student, teacher)
nodes.rationale: Numbering is blocked per portal (parent 1–19, student 20–39, teacher 40–59) so a capability found later joins its own portal. Built ahead of the rest of the admin dashboard because classroom features already built have no correct home until the portals exist.

nodes.label: A withheld figure is absent, not zero
nodes.rationale: Consent-gated figures are omitted rather than shown as zero; a DRAFT register is labelled 'not yet submitted' because telling a parent their child was absent off an unfinished register starts an argument; 'no marks' must say the school has not released them yet.

nodes.label: Iteration 7 — Messaging and payments
nodes.rationale: One messaging primitive serving teacher-parent threads, class broadcast and notice replies; and one payment primitive (EcoCash, OneMoney, bank transfer, card) that the parent and student payment stories sit on.

nodes.label: Iteration 8 — Offline
nodes.rationale: Sold explicitly: attendance capture and fee receipting keep working with no connection and sync once it returns, through lib/offline/module-registry.ts and the outbox, with conflict resolution for duplicate submissions.

nodes.label: Iteration 9 — Dashboard, reporting and notifications
nodes.rationale: A head's dashboard about this term rather than row counts, absence/fee/results notifications on the existing pipeline, a schools notification preference category, a real school notice entity, and a board reporting pack.

nodes.label: Iteration 10 — Visual and mobile pass
nodes.rationale: Every admin surface at 390x844, every surface at 768x1024, portals compared against their prototypes, avatars wherever people are listed, and a cover grid for the library because a debt is not browsed but a book is.

nodes.label: Parked schools stories
nodes.rationale: Behaviour/merits/discipline is parked because it is sold in no band and no add-on and absent from all three prototypes; the communications log is superseded by the messaging primitive.
